name: PNB MasterCard Platinum Rise Debit Card
description: PNB MasterCard Platinum Rise Debit Card is a PNB MASTERCARD PLATINUM RISE from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 50,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 300,000/day. Valid 7 years.
tagline: MasterCard Platinum debit card from PNB — international usage with ATM + POS access.

benefits.title: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Domestic Airport lounge program for RuPay Platinum Debit Card provides access to cardholders One (1) time per calendar year per card in any of the participating Domestic Airport lounges.

features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps and ATMs across India

notes: All Individuals of age from 18 years to 28 years and account opened under eligible schemes.
